data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'abhah', meaning radiant, shining, and bright. This name is often given to babies born during the daytime or during a time of joy and celebration. The name Abhah carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining, Bright” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Abhah usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abhah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
